name: create_health_endpoint_python
description: Creates a FastAPI health-check endpoint with a Pydantic response model
prompts: Create a FastAPI app in app.py with a Pydantic model `HealthStatus` that has a single field `status: str`. Add a GET /health endpoint that returns a `HealthStatus` with status set to "ok". The app object must be named `app`.

test_setup_files.test_health.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error
srv = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-m', 'uvicorn', 'app:app', '--port', '8001'])
try:
    body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8001/health', timeout=1) as resp:
                assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
                body = json.loads(resp.read())
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert body is not None, 'server never became reachable on :8001'
    assert body.get('status') == 'ok', f'unexpected body: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
